category: speech-to-text and text-to-speech API, one-time signup credit

free_tier.stated: USD 100 credit grant at signup on the Free plan, no card required; one credit is worth one US dollar, and one balance covers Speech to Text, add-ons and Text to Speech. One-time, not a monthly allowance. Melia 1 pre-recorded base rate is USD 0.24 per hour.
free_tier.notes: models on the pricing page: Melia 1 (multilingual, 56 languages), Enhanced, Standard, Oak 1 (clinical language) and Linden 1 (voice agents), in batch (REST) and real-time (WebSocket) modes. unverified: whether the grant expires, because no vendor page read states a validity period; unverified: the rate for Text to Speech, which the pricing page names without a number

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: an inference endpoint stores nothing for the caller

egress.terms: the response is the payload; no separate egress term is published

interface_detail: Batch REST API and real-time WebSocket API; an API key is created in the web portal; Python and JavaScript batch libraries. Batch base https://eu1.asr.api.speechmatics.com/v2 (also https://us1.asr.api.speechmatics.com/v2 and https://au1.asr.api.speechmatics.com/v2 for non-enterprise tiers; legacy alias https://asr.api.speechmatics.com/v2), with POST /jobs, GET /jobs, GET /jobs/{jobid}, GET /jobs/{jobid}/transcript and GET /usage under /v2. Realtime WebSocket at wss://eu.rt.speechmatics.com/v2 (also us, au, and wss://global.rt.speechmatics.com/v2). Auth is a Bearer API key in the Authorization header.
tooling: speechmatics-batch (Python), speechmatics-rt (Python), @speechmatics/batch-client (JavaScript); raw HTTP POST https://eu1.asr.api.speechmatics.com/v2/jobs and WebSocket wss://eu.rt.speechmatics.com/v2, both with Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY; key created at https://portal.speechmatics.com/settings/api-keys.
chaining: the credit pays for batch transcription of recorded audio, which a free CI runner can post file by file; pair it with a free object store for the audio. The discounted headline rate on the pricing page needs a Pro plan with model training and a top-tier annual commitment, so a Free account pays the base rate.

limits.value: USD 100 credit grant at signup, one-time; Melia 1 pre-recorded base rate USD 0.24 per hour

Free plan real-time sessions are capped at 2 concurrent (Pro 50); the batch API asks for no more than 10 new jobs per second and 50 job-status requests per second, with a backstop of 20,000 concurrent jobs

binding_note: the one-time USD 100 credit is the ceiling for batch work; the 2 concurrent real-time sessions cap is a second wall for live audio

identity_cost.detail: no payment card on the Free plan ('no payment card required'); signup is an email with a password or a Google or GitHub account, and an email signup must verify the address by a link; unverified: whether a phone number is asked

reliability_note: the Free plan runs on the granted credit only; adding a payment card moves the account to Pro, where usage beyond the granted credits is charged to the card
confidence_note: Endpoint, routes and bearer scheme come from the first-party Swagger spec and auth page read 2026-11-18; a keyless probe returned 401 on each batch host as expected. Key value and per-account behavior remain unverified: behind a sign-up.
